messages:
deploy-bot: Initiating staggered deploy to dedicated-eu2 (private)

deploy-bot: rollout id=rl-1976543210, tag=v2.3.1-rc3, commit=8f3c2d9, change-window=2200-2359 UTC

maria: ack — starting monitoring hooks, will run smoke group-1 on canary hosts

sam: kicking off smoke -> `curl -sS https://dedicated-eu2.canary.health/ready` returned 200 on 3/3 hosts

deploy-bot: canary phase: hosts updated 3/3, traffic=5%

kevin-w: seeing p95 token latency jump on canaries: baseline ~180ms, current ~1.1s for common prompts
anika: any repro? sample logs?
sam: paste log excerpt:
```
[2026-05-02T22:03:12Z] model-infer: seq_len=1024 batch=1 p99=1.12s p95=1.06s
[2026-05-02T22:03:13Z] kvcache: miss_rate=0.04 cpu% 43 gpu% 67
```

jax: that p95 is concerning for latency SLOs. Does this affect throughput or just long prompts?

maria: it's across short and medium prompts in smoke set. CPU on host looks fine, GPU util okay — maybe kernel selection regression in this build?

kevin-w: recommend pausing further rollout. Suggest pin back canary -> v2.3.0 and mark rl-1976543210 as paused for investigation.
anika: +1. start rollback on canaries only, keep rest of staggered deploy paused. We should capture full traces before rollback.
sam: grabbing traces now — running `deployctl trace rl-1976543210 --since 5m > traces/1976543210-canary.log`

deploy-bot: Action: pausing staggered deploy at 5% traffic. Executing canary rollback to tag=v2.3.0 (commit=7b9a1c6).
deploy-bot: rollback job queued (job-id rb-1976543210-1)

maria: copying smoke logs to #incidents for longer retention, adding links in ticket INF-482

jax: once rollback completes, let's re-run the optimized kernel regression test matrix from eng-runtime. If that fails, we need to revert the kernel selection change in the build.

deploy-bot: rollback completed on canary hosts (3/3) — tag now v2.3.0, traffic=5%

kevin-w: after rollback, p95 back to ~190ms on the same smoke prompts. Confirming recovery.

anika: good. keep staggered deploy paused. Ops will schedule a short postmortem and determine whether to publish a hotfix or re-run candidate with kernel fixes.

maria: noted. I'll update the release notes draft: add "paused due to latency regression on dedicated-eu2 canary; rolled back to v2.3.0; investigation ongoing" and the rl id.

sam: creating a small test harness to reproduce; will post steps in INF-482.

deploy-bot: rl-1976543210 status=paused, current_tag=v2.3.0, note="canary rollback performed due to p95 regression"

maria: thanks all. If anyone finds a quick root cause, ping here. Otherwise we'll reconvene at 23:15 UTC for next steps. :thumbsup:"
